fieldAuthority: C01-20261022-v1 product_image.image_role/color_id approved; native metadata/version/creator/time retained. No additional DB fields proposed.
currentGap: W2 editor snapshot has no image roles/versions. Existing frozen images/query exposes only id/label/thumbnailUrl; media provider null yields explicit501. This contract supplies real upload/edit/read capability without changing frozen drawer DTO v1.

roles.label: 颜色配图
roles.colorId: actual selected product SKU color UUID

legacy: Existing image_role=NULL/color_id=NULL means unknown; preserve and display 未分类, never infer MAIN from filename/order. No new MAIN singleton or implicit deletion. Replacement can preserve NULL only for an already unknown-role image; new ADD requires one known role.

images.role: five-value enum | null for retained unknown
images.thumbnailUrl: authenticated opaque same configured HTTPS origin URL | null when thumbnail unavailable

editorRead.rules: Current product maintenance read authorization; all metadata and root version in one snapshot; stable global ORDER BY display_order,id, grouping by role only in F2. Preserve gaps/equal orders rather than silently renumbering. No fileRef/path/storage URL/raw original/base64 in response. Null creator remains unknown.
editorRead.emptyVsFailure: No actual images => images[]. Metadata/permission/read errors => explicit failure, never []. Missing thumbnail => UNAVAILABLE, never serve original as thumbnail.
editorRead.readCompatibility: Existing images/query and image/query shape and URLs remain; richer editor endpoint is separate. Read/thumbnails do not fetch original bytes; original only on explicit original request.

headers.X-Product-Id: actual UUID for EDIT; omitted only for CREATE draft

upload.body: raw binary, size 1..8388608 bytes exactly native product_image bound; no data URL, JSON base64, remote URL, file path or client MIME trust
upload.authentication: Current authenticated ADMIN/WAREHOUSE per D1 product-maintenance policy; validate Origin/CSRF through host, actual target scope for EDIT; CREATE authority for draft. Bind stage to current actor, root-or-new scope, original command key and upload key.
upload.validation: Check magic and fully decode via explicit trusted image codec; actual MIME must match supported transport MIME; enforce configured decoded-pixel/dimension limits and abort. Original bytes preserved as uploaded, derived thumbnail stored separately. No SVG/HTML/path import.
upload.storage: Private immutable durable blob plus derived thumbnail prepared before DB mutation. Storage root explicit outside dist/web/static, permissions bounded; no public fallback. Existing legacy fileRef resolves only through approved private root mapping with canonical path/symlink containment checks.
upload.idempotency: Same actor/command/upload key and exact bytes returns same stage; changed bytes or scope under same key returns409. No auto retry. Stage opaque UUID and private manifest contain ownership/digest/size/mime/expiry; manifest private, never credentials. Actual save revalidates stage ownership/content/expiry.
upload.notCommitted: Upload response only means staged private file, not saved product/image. Image becomes visible only after root transaction commits.
upload.cleanup: Cancel/failed save/uncertain COMMIT must not delete staged/original files. C-controlled cleanup only after checking actual image/audit/receipt references and unknown commits; no automatic deletion in D2 implementation.

write.transport: Extend C-frozen v2 product CREATE/EDIT with mandatory imageChanges array ([] means no image edits). If season DDL is still pending, C may freeze this same independent image extension first; media must not itself require new season relation.

add.uploadId: owned valid staged UUID bound to same original command
add.colorId: UUID only for COLOR, else null

replace.role: known role; legacy null allowed only if preserving unknown

metadata.role: known role; legacy null only if preserving unknown

rules: Existing product same native root expectedVersion and lock; every existing image also actual version CAS. No image may occur twice across operations; no cross-product binding; missing image is error.

ADD allocates real image UUID, version1, actual time/current actor. REPLACE preserves image id/product/created_at/created_by, increments image.version once; new file/mime/size from validated stage. Metadata edit increments once; REMOVE deletes only actual relation row.

Check final picture set and actual final product SKU colors in same transaction; COLOR unique(product,color) holds. Existing retained color images prevent removing their SKU-color identity. Non-COLOR requires colorId null.
One PRODUCT EDIT/CREATE operation/root.version increment even with several image changes. No extra IMAGE root receipt or fake subtype action.

Full actual changed old/new image row facts including native metadata and role/color in D1 before_values.images/after_values.images. Full unchanged images omitted. REMOVE only in before; ADD only in after.

Prepare audit first, CAS root, apply removals before conflicting COLOR additions/updates, write real image rows, complete identical original receipt, COMMIT. Any error rolls back DB part; blob retention enables retry/readback.
Original blob files and previous replacements remain private and preserved; removing display relation does not authorize deleting physical source/history files.
Root receipt stays exact four keys. Authoritative editor reread supplies new actual image ids/versions. Original-key replay recovers receipt without a second image attachment.

500: sanitized INTERNAL_ERROR; original command key readback

delivery.revision: Opaque current-content fingerprint from trusted private metadata; no storage path. Verify against current DB row before delivering bytes. v2 metadata uses actual image.version for CAS; URL revision is not an authority token.
rules: Fresh authenticated actor, fresh exact product/image grant and actual image membership on EVERY byte request. URL possession never grants access.
Replacement/removal or changed content invalidates stale revision. Deleted image/product or revoked permission cannot be served from cache.

Only private approved path resolution; reject traversal, symlink escapes, arbitrary URLs and unsupported stored MIME. Stream exact bounded original or separate verified thumbnail; never whole catalog preload.
Cache-Control:no-store, Pragma:no-cache, X-Content-Type-Options:nosniff and actual Content-Type. Generic sanitized errors hide fileRef/root/SQL.
resolveThumbnails batches metadata and creates controlled URLs without opening original bytes; no original fallback. Missing thumbnail is unavailable until approved processing.
Credentials remain host/session managed; no access token or raw storage signature in browser-visible URL.
